name: ModelBridge
description: ModelBridge offers a monthly free allowance on its Chinese-model gateway.
overview: ModelBridge advertises 500,000 tokens per month on its free plan plus a one-time 500,000 token welcome bonus. Its pricing page says all models are available and no card is required; its documentation lists 20 requests and 50,000 tokens per minute on Free. Calls beyond the allowance can incur charges, so check account limits and billing before use.
notes: Use deepseek-chat at https://aibridge-api.com/v1; pricing and live model availability may change.
